verdicts.reason: In both, the photo is cropped to a meaningless sliver of sweater on the right, so the woman, mug and gift are lost, and centred copy runs onto the busy knit pattern. A's 'GET A GIFT' headline is shrunk to roughly the size of the 'with your next cup of coffee' subhead, which inverts the hierarchy, and its stars are enlarged and oddly placed. B keeps the headline dominant, but 'GIFT' and the gift icons sit directly on the red-and-white sweater pattern, which hurts legibility. B also has a ragged 'with your / next' break and a cramped bottom area. B is less bad because its hierarchy holds.
